decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The application for the erection of a single storey rear extension, replacement of all windows with U-PVC windows and installation of 2 roof lights to rear of the house, as shown on drawing numbers KGS/GUN/263P/1B, Received 11 December 2006; and unnumbered window design plans, received 21 November 2006, is recommended for approval as it would not harm the appearance of the existing building or the amenity of neighbouring properties and would preserve and maintain the appearance and character of Gunnersbury Park Conservation Area. Therefore the proposed development complies with the relevant London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 policies; ENV-B.1.1 New Development, ENV-B.2.2 Conservation Areas and H.6.4 Extensions and Alterations, and the Supplementary Planning Guidance.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 5 - The roof lights shall be installed to be flush with the existing roof slope and have a 'conservation style' with a central mullion.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension, replacement of all windows with uPVC and installation of 2 rooflights to rear of the house
